intro: Time never holds us but moment does... what we cherish in our heart forever

items.caption: Learning like endless sky never ends

items.alt: A sunset on the Padma River, Rajshahi
items.caption: Before dark on the vast Padma river, Rajshahi
items.writeup: I was preparing for my university admission in Rajshahi in 2014. Me and my friends hired a boat and was floating on the vast Padma river. It was at the end of the day, before dark i captured the moment.
